cases.why: Model B's shape is emptied. Every colour check stays green because no colour moved, and the chart still draws -- it just draws one series with nothing but hue to identify it. That is the encoding --accent/--series-d is ACCEPTED on: at 1.26 apart under deuteranopia the My Picks line is told apart by its diamond, its dash and its label before colour is consulted, and the moment a series is hue-only that reasoning no longer describes the page.

the market takes Model A's circle. Subtler than deleting a shape: every series still HAS one, so a guard that only asked whether a shape exists is satisfied, and the legend still renders four rows. Two of them are now a circle in two blues, which is precisely the failure the shape encoding exists to prevent -- and on the reliability diagram those two overlap on one plot.

Model B picks up a dash too. It reads as a harmless styling choice and takes away a distinction nothing else replaces: the ACCEPTED_CLOSE entry for --accent/--series-d says in as many words that My Picks is the ONLY dashed stroke on the plot, so a second dashed line falsifies a written verdict rather than merely looking different. Nothing errors and no colour check notices.
